'''Ben McDonald''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 1999 Jester's Court tournament]] on 16 October 1999 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d78">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-18-jesters-court-10-16-99d78/ jesters-court-10-16-99], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 18 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-18-jesters-court-10-16-99d78/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
